pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft electronic piano repeating gentle warm patterns, ambient pad floating softly, narrow room reverb, subtle air texture, no vocal)

[Verse 1]
(soft electronic piano, deep sub bass rumble, distant whispered male vocal behind piano)
햇살이 너를 감싸던 그날처럼 Like the day sunlight embraced you
내 마음도 따뜻해져 가 My heart grows warmer
작은 웃음, 네 손끝의 떨림까지 Even your small smile and trembling fingertips

[Soft Build]
(soft electronic piano layers increasing subtly, ambient pad warm glow, deep sub bass soft pulse, whispered male vocal with long reverb)
모두 다 내게는 기적 같아 All feel like miracles to me
수많은 계절이 지나가도 Even as many seasons pass

[Break]
(piano only with long reverb tail, narrow room reflections, subtle wind tone, almost no rhythm)

[Verse 2]
(soft electronic piano, deep sub bass, ambient pad, distant whispered male vocal)
너와 함께하는 시간들은 The times spent with you
모두 행복의 연속이야 Are all a continuation of happiness
하루가 다르게 빛나가는 세상 The world shines brighter each day

[Emotional Peak]
(soft electronic piano with warmer layers, deeper but gentle sub bass, ambient pads expand softly, male vocal with cavernous reverb still behind piano)
너로 인해 아름다워져 Because of you it becomes beautiful
별빛이 우리를 비추는 이 밤에 Under the starlight shining on us tonight
너의 눈 속에 나를 비춰봐 See me in your eyes
말하지 않아도 느낄 수 있어 I can feel it without words
우리 마음은 하나라는 걸 Our hearts are one
조용한 바람에 실려오는 Your breath carried on the quiet wind

[Outro]
(soft electronic piano fading gently, long ambient pad and reverb tails, deep sub bass slowly dissolving, distant male vocal echo, very long reverb decay into silence)
너와 함께하는 시간들은 The times spent with you
이대로 멈춰도 괜찮아 It's okay to stay like this
내 전부는 너야, 사랑해 You are my everything, I love you
끝나지 않을 노래처럼 Like an endless song
(extended reverb and empty space, gradual fade out)
pkg.sunoStyle: Dreamy ambient EDM with deep house influence. Piano: soft warm electronic piano, crystal clear high-end, bright attack, clean transient, front, dry, NOT muffled. Bass: deep sub bass, strong and clearly audible, clean and controlled, stays below vocal. Drums: very minimal, soft slow pulse. VOCAL: male bass voice, very deep low register, heavy chest resonance, dense and thick vocal body, compressed vocal tone, tight low-mid focus, strong and forward presence, voice must feel physically close and heavy, spoken or chant-like delivery, slow controlled phrasing. NO airy, NO breathy, NO thin voice. MIX: vocal dominant and forward, piano clean and bright in front but not overpowering, bass supports depth without masking vocal. SPACE: short tight reverb + deep echo behind only, no washed-out vocal. Atmosphere: dark ambient, night, immersive. Tempo: 65-72 BPM. Restrictions: no distant vocal, no soft vocal, no weak presence. Voice similar to epic cinematic trailer narrator.
